prompt: A large rectangle is $10 \times 8$. A $2 \times 3$ rectangle is cut out. Find the remaining area.
hint: When a piece is cut out of a shape, the area that is left is the whole area minus the piece.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try smaller numbers: a $3 \times 3$ square with a $1 \times 1$ square cut out has $9 - 1 = 8$ squares left.
When a piece is cut out of a shape, the area that is left is the whole area minus the piece.
The large rectangle has area $10 \times 8 = 80$ and the cut-out has area $2 \times 3 = 6$. Subtract the small area from the large one.
$80 - 6 = 74$, so the remaining area is $74$ square units.

explanation: Find the area of the large rectangle before anything is removed: $10 \times 8 = 80$.
Find the area of the piece that is cut out: $2 \times 3 = 6$.
The cut-out is no longer part of the shape, so subtract it: $80 - 6 = 74$.
The remaining area is $74$ square units.
